dogecoin.text: On the blog: Jackson Palmer (Dogecoin creator), looking at the past to see what the future holds for the crypto space https://t.co/3gBScUocR1

First Elon Musk pumps Dogecoin, then he calls it a hustle. Then it corrects!

Most interesting to see that Bloomberg refers to @coingecko and not @CoinMarketCap for data!

https://t.co/Z6EoS87oXu

“In engineer parlance, this satirical trait isn’t a bug in Dogecoin. It’s a feature.

Musk gets the joke, and his fans like the way he tells it. He may be right that Dogecoin is a hustle. But to those craving democratization of the financial markets, at least it’s their hustle.”
